comment: Dr. Obiorah is a great professor, she is patient and her lectures are easy to follow.
She's really patient, but the class is kind of boring. There are tons of assignments, and both her PowerPoints and homework are mostly just copied from the textbook

Dr. Obiorah is extremely patient. Can be a little boring at times. Lecture slides help when doing the labs and studying for the exam. Super accessible, just reach out and she'll help you as much as you need.

She makes computer science boring, simply put. I've had much better CS teachers. It was an easy class, I learned a good amount, but I couldn't wait to get out of class. I wouldn't recommed for you not to take the class, because 221 is necessary for a CS person, but there is a lot of room for improvement for professor Obiorah, but I respect her.

Professor Obiorah had great lecture slides and while she assigns a lot of homework, she's a pretty laid back teacher. Her tests and quizzes are all very doable and she prepares you pretty well with practice tests. As long as you try to pay attention during lectures, you'll be completely fine

Overall a great class. Professor Obiorah has great slides and lectures and provides excellent practice opportunities in class. Exams are easy compared to quizzes. One annoying thing is that she gives lots of assignments, especially be prepared to finish those that are due in the midst of your semester break.

Dr. Obiorah had the best lecture slides but her teaching per se was not the most favorable. She will cover too much in one lecture and you may have to do a quiz on it the same day or 2 days later. Her midterm and final were not difficult; just revise the review exercises she gives.
